title: Delete a UFW firewall rule
summary: Remove a specific rule from the UFW firewall configuration. You need the rule's number, which can be found by listing the status.

steps.explain: Delete a rule by its number. The number is obtained from 'sudo ufw status numbered'.

placeholders.name: RULE_NUMBER
placeholders.description: The index number of the rule to delete.

rollback.explain: Re-add the rule manually using 'sudo ufw allow' or 'sudo ufw deny' with the original parameters.

placeholders.name: PORT
placeholders.description: The port number that was previously allowed.

warnings: Deleting a rule may open or close access to services unexpectedly.
